readerQuestion: What should I check before sharing text from a conversation with a GirlfriendGPT character?

applicableClaims.name: GirlfriendGPT Terms of Use
applicableClaims.note: The terms distinguish paid entitlement and payment processors. They cover rights and restrictions for platform material, user contributions and certain text from chats with characters the user devised.

applicableClaims.name: GirlfriendGPT Privacy Notice
applicableClaims.note: The notice describes content, account, marketing preferences and the right to access a copy of personal data. It distinguishes visitors from subscribed users.

illustration.alt: Identify the character creator, Mark the exact text, Check the sharing purpose.

editorialReview.readerAction: Check who authored the character, which text you want to share and what rights or private details it contains.
editorialReview.factBasis: Primary sources and an explicitly fictional example. No product operation is claimed.
editorialReview.productionReview: The compiled Worker, all release boundaries and formal site are checked separately.
